justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the connected workspace, user, grants and proposal counts. It does not change work records or start a workflow; server audit logging is incidental.
justifications.destructive_justification: Retrieval only; it cannot overwrite, delete, cancel, publish or send work content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is confined to the authenticated Taskeya workspace and current project permissions; no public search or arbitrary destination is used.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Repeating this read does not change work records; incidental audit entries do not change its read semantics.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists a task/comment approval proposal; it can replace an existing proposal when its ID and current version are provided.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replacement overwrites saved proposal content and supersedes its pending operations. Actual task/comment changes require a separate owner approval in Taskeya.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only persists the approval batch inside the connected Taskeya workspace. It does not execute the proposed changes or deliver comments.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Pending proposals may be deduplicated, but repeating after expiry or completion can create another proposal, so general idempotence is not promised.

justifications.read_only_justification: Immediately saves comments on authorized tasks and notifies eligible assignees and mentioned workspace members. A Tasky mention may add an AI reply.
justifications.destructive_justification: Posts content to other users and delivers notifications; removing the saved comment cannot undo content already delivered or read.
justifications.open_world_justification: Recipients and tasks are bounded by the authenticated Taskeya workspace. No arbitrary destination is accepted; Tasky uses the configured service without web-search or tool execution.
justifications.idempotent_justification: A required idempotency key deduplicates the same operation payload for this connection; retries return the recorded batch without executing the work twice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Immediately soft-deletes the explicitly identified authorized tasks after checking their current versions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes tasks from active work and emits deletion webhooks. Recoverability does not make this non-destructive.
justifications.open_world_justification: Archiving dispatches subscribed board deletion webhooks to configured external URLs.
justifications.idempotent_justification: A required idempotency key deduplicates the same operation payload for this connection; retries return the recorded batch without executing the work twice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Immediately creates a project, its canonical task board and requested memberships inside the authorized workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new project and associated records; it does not overwrite or delete existing work or send a message.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates only within the authenticated Taskeya workspace and its existing users, teams and clients. Workspace visibility is not public-internet publication.
justifications.idempotent_justification: A required idempotency key deduplicates the same operation payload for this connection; retries return the recorded batch without executing the work twice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Immediately creates a registered board and its template records inside an authorized project. Lead or booking boards also create their initial draft form and settings.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds new board records, columns, groups and type-specific draft configuration; it does not overwrite existing boards or publish forms.
justifications.open_world_justification: The board belongs to the authorized project. Provisioned forms remain drafts; this call does not publish a public link or contact arbitrary external destinations.
justifications.idempotent_justification: A required idempotency key deduplicates the same operation payload for this connection; retries return the recorded batch without executing the work twice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists a project-deletion approval proposal and its impact summary.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a proposal; it neither deletes the project nor starts an executable deletion job. Deletion requires a separate owner review and approval in Taskeya.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only inspects the authorized project and saves a proposal within the connected Taskeya workspace.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Pending proposals may be deduplicated, but repeating after expiry or completion can create another proposal, so general idempotence is not promised.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists a non-canonical board-deletion approval proposal and its impact summary.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only adds a proposal; it neither deletes the board nor starts an executable deletion job. Deletion requires a separate owner review and approval in Taskeya.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only inspects the authorized board and saves a proposal within the connected Taskeya workspace.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Pending proposals may be deduplicated, but repeating after expiry or completion can create another proposal, so general idempotence is not promised.

justifications.read_only_justification: Persists an approval proposal to create or update a draft report; it can replace an existing proposal using its ID and current version.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replacement overwrites saved proposal content and supersedes pending operations. Actual report changes require separate owner approval in Taskeya.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only saves a proposal inside the authorized workspace; it does not publish, share or send the report.
justifications.idempotent_justification: Pending proposals may be deduplicated, but repeating after expiry or completion can create another proposal, so general idempotence is not promised.

justifications.read_only_justification: Immediately creates tasks in existing authorized boards after autonomous-write consent and permission checks.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creation can deliver notifications and configured automation messages that cannot be recalled. The tool does not overwrite existing tasks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Task writes can trigger configured board webhooks and automations that send to external URLs, email or Slack destinations.
justifications.idempotent_justification: A required idempotency key deduplicates the same operation payload for this connection; retries return the recorded batch without executing the work twice.
